name: Checkbox
summary: A native checkbox with a persistent label and an optional mixed state.
usage: Use for independent on/off choices and for select-all controls whose options are partly chosen. The checked value stays caller-owned. Native input props and refs are forwarded.
accessibility: The native input stays focusable and announced while a drawn box shows checked, mixed, focus and disabled states; the whole label toggles it. indeterminate sets the native mixed state that assistive technology reports.

props.name: label
props.meaning: Visible label that names the checkbox.

props.name: indeterminate
props.meaning: Shows the mixed state, for example when only some options are chosen.

props.name: …inputProps
props.meaning: Native props such as checked, onChange, disabled, name and ref are forwarded.

examples.label: Checkbox states
examples.description: Checked, mixed and disabled examples held locally.
